scenes.name: Wu-Tang Clan
scenes.book: The Come Up: An Oral History of the Rise of Hip-Hop
scenes.author: Jonathan Abrams
scenes.desc: Mientras el G-funk dominaba la radio, el debut de Wu-Tang revitalizó Nueva York. RZA había formado Force of the Imperial Master con sus primos GZA y Ol’ Dirty Bastard; con Ghostface Killah, Inspectah Deck, U-God, Method Man, Masta Killa y Raekwon (y luego Cappadonna) fueron nueve. «Protect Ya Neck», autoeditado (ocho MCs sin estribillo), circuló por The Source y por una radio de Detroit y llevó a Steve Rifkind de Loud: RZA negoció un contrato inédito en el que cada miembro podía firmar en solitario con otro sello (Method Man con Def Jam, ODB con Elektra, GZA con Geffen) y el grupo acabó compitiendo consigo mismo en las listas. Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers) (1993), con samples de soul acelerados (que imitaría Kanye West) y diálogos de películas de kung-fu, impuso un vocabulario nuevo; fueron una empresa: Wu Wear, sellos propios.
scenes.family: Nueva York: Def Jam, Queens y la edad de oro

podcast.title: Co-Founder and Business Leader of Wu Tang Clan
podcast.body: RZA, alongside GZA (Jason), was the architect behind the formation of the Wu Tang Clan, envisioning a unique project different from the market. He served as the primary creative and, more significantly, entrepreneurial leader of the group, meticulously planning their business strategy, particularly the innovative record deal and the "five-year plan" for solo releases. "Reisa fue el que lideró el butanclan creativamente en parte, pero, sobre todo, a nivel empresarial"

srcs.episode: Wu Tang Clan. Historia viva del Hip Hop

podcast.title: Creative and Political Role
podcast.body: While RZA always played a significant role as a creative director within the Wu-Tang Clan, his primary function was that of a political leader. He made the important decisions for the band, focusing on its economic and strategic direction rather than solely its creative output. "Aunque Reiza dentro del Gutanclan, siempre ha ejercido un rol muy de director creativo, también ha ejercido principalmente un rol político."

podcast.title: Five-Year Plan Architect
podcast.body: RZA convinced all members to accept him as the absolute and despotic leader for at least five years, empowering him to make all decisions for the band. This leadership was critical for implementing his five-year plan, which dictated the staggered release of solo albums. "convencerlos a todos para que al menos durante 5 años, Reiza sea el líder absoluto y despota que toma las decisiones dentro de la banda."

podcast.title: Founding Vision
podcast.body: From the very beginning, when RZA co-founded the Wu-Tang Clan with Suprimoth, he took the reins with a clear and specific vision for the group's economic future. He knew precisely what he wanted to achieve and where he wanted to go financially, with a clear entrepreneurial outlook. "Cuando Reiza y Suprimoth fundan el Gutanclan, él ya toma las riendas desde un principio, ya tiene una idea muy concreta de lo que queda hacer y de dónde quiere llegar económicamente."

podcast.title: Political Leader of Wu-Tang Clan
podcast.body: RZA served as the political leader of the Wu-Tang Clan, a role distinct from a purely creative leader. He was responsible for making the band's crucial economic and strategic decisions, guiding its overall direction. "Reiza es el líder del Gutanclan, pero es ese líder político que suelen tener las bandas."

podcast.title: Previous Solo Work
podcast.body: Before the formation of Wu Tang Clan, RZA, then known as Prince Rakimi, had released a solo album that was not successful. "Reisa, el gran líder del Wu Tang Clan había trabajado como Prince Rakimi y llegó a sacar un disco que no había tenido éxito."
